## Priorities

Inner peace, Health, Wealth.

## Rules

- Hang out with nice people, avoid jerks - including yourself.
- Cut Imaginary Dragons.
- "If you seek tranquility, do less." – Marcus Aurelius.
- Budget - time, food, money.
- Never Be Overheard Complaining, even to yourself.

## Closing

- Align your feelings with your goals.
- Train your mind to believe in your potential and move ahead one step at a time.
- Believe and achieve.
- Believe and manifest.
